summary: Tested live backend and responsive frontend flows: auth, protected generation, admin stats, details, print, mentor chat, and logout path.

critical.issue: Generated project objects do not include persisted IDs (existing regression test fails all('id' in p)); this prevents reliable project identity/save/delete flows.

ui_bugs.issue: App renders Nav globally and Shell renders another Nav, producing duplicate mobile headers. Duplicate logout buttons cause selector ambiguity and the visible menu can be inaccessible without opening the correct nav.

integration_issues.issue: Logout could not be clicked because two matching buttons exist and the first is hidden; browser flow stopped at logout.

action_items: Return inserted project IDs from POST /api/projects/generate, or capture insert_many result IDs and attach them to each response project.
Render a single navigation header; remove the duplicate Nav inside Shell or the global Nav, then retest mobile menu/logout.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/projects/generate inserts documents but intentionally returns documents without IDs (line 125), violating the requested save/details identity contract.
The /favorites route renders HistoryPage without filtering saved projects, so Favorites is not functionally distinct.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flow passed; logout blocked by duplicate nav)

seed_data_creation: Created one temporary TEST_ registration account through the regression test; no seeded production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live admin login and generation with team_size='3 members' pass. UI generation, details, print, and mentor chat pass. Recheck IDs, save/delete/favorites, mobile nav/logout, and Google managed redirect callback.
rca of the issue: Generation builds docs and calls insert_many, but response is constructed from pre-insert docs and omits inserted IDs. Duplicate Nav is caused by App rendering Nav globally while authenticated route Shell renders Nav again.
